sonExH.modesDesc: The questions are the same, written with the right words for him or for her.
sonExH.q1a: Almost never, and without much emotion.
sonExH.q1b: Now and then, like a memory.
sonExH.q1c: Often, even when it has nothing to do with anything.
sonExH.q1d: Very often, and with a lot of emotion, good or bad.
sonExH.q2: Does he compare you to his ex?
sonExH.q2d: Often, and not always in your favor.
sonExH.q3b: Only for practical reasons: kids, a home, work.
sonExH.q3c: Yes, they text now and then, and you know about it.
sonExH.q3d: Yes, and he hides it from you, or plays it down.
sonExH.q4: When he finds out his ex is seeing someone, or that her life is changing...
sonExH.q4b: He's a bit curious, nothing more.
sonExH.q4d: He's jealous, or in a bad mood for days.
sonExH.q5: Does he check his ex's social media?
sonExH.q5a: No, he doesn't follow his ex anymore.
sonExH.q5b: He still follows his ex, nothing more.
sonExH.q5c: He watches her stories and photos, you've seen him do it.
sonExH.q5d: He closely follows everything his ex posts, and reacts.
sonExH.q6: Did he keep things from that relationship: photos, gifts, letters?
sonExH.q6a: No, or just photos on an old hard drive.
sonExH.q6b: A few things, put away somewhere.
sonExH.q6c: Yes, and they mean a lot to him.
sonExH.q6d: Yes, out in plain sight, and he refuses to part with them.
sonExH.q7a: He was the one who left.
sonExH.q7c: His ex left him, and he didn't see it coming.
sonExH.q7d: He's never explained it to you.
sonExH.q8: How long was it between their breakup and when you met?
sonExH.q8d: A few weeks, or almost no time.
sonExH.q9: Does he talk about your future together: trips, moving in, plans?
sonExH.q9b: A little, when you bring it up.
sonExH.q9d: He says he doesn't know where he stands.
sonExH.q10: Has he ever called you by his ex's name?
sonExH.q10b: Once, and it made him laugh.
sonExH.q11: On the dates that mattered in their story (his ex's birthday, their anniversary), he's...
sonExH.q11c: Distant, or in a bad mood.
sonExH.q12: When you ask a question about his ex, he...
sonExH.q12b: Changes the subject, a bit awkward.
sonExH.q12d: Talks about it for an hour.
sonExH.q13: Does he keep ties with his ex's family or friends?
sonExH.q13b: He runs into them now and then.
sonExH.q13d: He asks them for news about his ex.
sonExH.q14: When he talks about his ex, it's mostly...
sonExH.q14b: With fondness, like a closed chapter.
sonExH.q14c: With a lot of anger or resentment.
sonExH.q14d: With nostalgia, like those were the good old days.
sonExH.q15: Has he introduced you to the people close to him?
sonExH.q15c: Not yet, he always finds a reason.
sonExH.q15d: No, and he doesn't want to talk about it.
sonExH.q16: Does he avoid places, songs or shows because they remind him of his ex?
sonExH.q17: Do you feel like you're competing with his ex?
sonExH.q18: If he ran into his ex tomorrow by chance, he'd be...
sonExH.q18a: Indifferent: he'd say hi and move on.
sonExH.q18c: Thrown off for the whole day.
sonExH.q18d: He'd try to see her again.
sonExH.q19: Has he ever said he misses that relationship, or that he still thinks about his ex?
sonExH.q19b: He's said he regrets some things, nothing more.
sonExH.q19c: Yes, that he still thinks about his ex.
sonExH.q19d: Yes, that he'd like to turn back time.
sonExH.q20a: A chapter of his life, behind him.
sonExH.q20c: A failure he hasn't gotten over.
sonExH.r1_d: His ex is part of his past, not his life today. He rarely talks about her, without much emotion, and nothing you can see shows that she's still on his mind. Your doubts probably come from somewhere else.
sonExH.r1_a: If the question keeps coming back anyway, look at what triggers it for you: a detail, a time when you feel less sure of yourself? That's often where the answer is.
sonExH.r2_d: He thinks about his ex sometimes, the way everyone sometimes thinks about a relationship that mattered. But they're just memories: they don't spill over into your relationship, and nothing is hidden.
sonExH.r2_a: No need to make it a big deal. A question about his past now and then, asked simply, is enough to keep things clear between you.
sonExH.r3_t: His ex still takes up some space
sonExH.r3_d: Something isn't quite settled. He's not necessarily in love with his ex, but she comes back into his thoughts or his moods more often than a simple memory would. It could be nostalgia, a breakup he hasn't gotten over, or anger that hasn't died down.
sonExH.r3_a: Talk about it calmly, starting from how you feel, not from what he does. And give him a little time: a relationship that ended badly often takes longer to fade.
sonExH.r4_t: He's not quite over his ex
sonExH.r4_d: Several signs add up: he talks about her often, with emotion, and what happens to his ex still gets to him. It doesn't mean he wants to get back with her, or that he doesn't love you. It means part of him is still stuck in that story.
sonExH.r4_a: It's worth a real conversation. Pick a calm moment, tell him what you see and how it makes you feel, and ask him where he stands. His reaction will tell you as much as his answer.
sonExH.r5_t: His ex is still very much on his mind
sonExH.r5_d: Almost all your answers point the same way: his ex still takes up a big place in his life, sometimes in secret. Contact he hides from you, regrets he has said out loud, wanting to see her again... those aren't just memories anymore.
sonExH.r5_a: Don't stay alone with this doubt. Talk to him honestly, and also ask yourself what you're willing to accept: you deserve a full place in your relationship, not whatever is left over.
